sources.name: Canada internal trade
sources.coverage: Federal government explicitly states no tariffs on goods/services crossing internal borders. Permits, standards, prohibitions and administration can still add costs.
sources.adapter: Monitor pagehash; editorial review. Do not convert tariff-equivalent economic estimates into payable charges.

sources.name: CRA GST/HST for freight carriers

sources.publicationGate: Tax is not an internal-border tariff. GST/HST is not a complete government-charge total.
